recap.text: PhilCap have taken over the real standings with 172 points after a pool-best 65-point run since Oct 27, climbing from 11th. Tage Against the Machine (167), 97 Problems (165), Debits & Checks (164) and Lord of the Rinks (163) are bunched within nine points of them.
recap.impact: You jumped from 10th to 5th and sit 9 points off the real lead. With five teams this tight, a couple of good nights can flip the order.

recap.text: Lord of the Rinks are still the projected favourite at about 781 points and 27.9% to win. Debits & Checks (767, 16.0%), 97 Problems (765, 15.7%) and PhilCap (765, 14.4%) make up the chasing pack.
recap.impact: Your projected cushion grew from 6 points over 97 Problems on Oct 27 to 14 over Debits & Checks now.

recap.text: PhilCap had the biggest odds jump, from 4.8% to 14.4%, behind Leo Carlsson (13 points) and Jackson LaCombe (10). Poppy's Picks rose from 2.1% to 3.3% on 58 points. Dom Scavuzzo fell the most, from 15.3% to 10.2%, and 97 Problems slipped from 18.6% to 15.7%.
recap.impact: PhilCap are now a threat in both the standings and the projections, while two of your other chasers lost ground. Overall the picture is a bit better for you.

recap.text: Leo Carlsson led the pool with 13 points since Oct 27, followed by Cutter Gauthier and Beckett Sennecke (12 each), then Tage Thompson, Logan Cooley, Jackson LaCombe and Connor McDavid (10 each). Kirill Kaprizov led Lord of the Rinks with 9.
recap.impact: Your 56 points over that stretch were third-best in the pool, behind PhilCap (65) and Poppy's Picks (58).

recap.text: The Red Wings suspended Dylan Larkin without pay on Oct 29 after he told the team he would no longer play for Detroit, and no return date has been reported. Miro Heiskanen (Matthew's Team) is day-to-day, Patrick Kane (Anthony Scavuzzo) is out at least a couple of games, and Evgeni Malkin (Tage Against the Machine) is off the injury report.
recap.impact: Your roster is fully healthy. Larkin matters most: Debits & Checks are 2nd in the projections, and their 767 points count on him coming back.

recap.text: Role changes on Lord of the Rinks: Dylan Holloway has dropped to St. Louis's second power-play unit, Porter Martone is on Philadelphia's first, Anton Frondell is back on Chicago's first unit, and Jake Sanderson's ice time is now 8% below last season, up from 29% below.
recap.impact: Sanderson's minutes coming back is the best news here. Holloway's drop costs a little, and Martone and Frondell's power-play time helps a little.

lens.headline: A 56-point stretch lifted you from 10th to 5th, and you're still the team to beat in the projections.
bullets: You're 5th in the real standings with 163 points, 9 back of PhilCap, and projected to finish 1st with about 781.

You're about 14 points clear of Debits & Checks in the projections, with 97 Problems and PhilCap about 16 back. Holding that means keeping pace with PhilCap, who have outscored everyone since Oct 27.

Kaprizov (9 points), Reinhart (7) and Johnston (6) drove it. Kaprizov has 16 goals on 54 shots and Brady Tkachuk 8 on 51, rates that usually cool off, while Johnston (3 on 36) and Seider (0 on 32) are due for more.
Next week, watch whether Kaprizov keeps finishing, Holloway's power-play spot in St. Louis, and whether Sanderson's ice time keeps climbing.

lens.headline: Kaprizov's hat trick kept you in a three-way race, now 3rd projected.
bullets: You're 16th in the real standings with 29 points, but projected to finish 3rd with about 737, and your roster still projects 1st in the pool from here on.
Win odds slipped from 18.7% to 17.1% since last week's recap, and top-3 odds from 40% to 39%, as Dom Scavuzzo jumped past you from 4th to 1st projected.
The projected gap to 1st is about 6 points (737 to 743). Closing it comes down to your cold shooters: Wyatt Johnston, Sam Reinhart and Brady Tkachuk have 35 shots between them and no goals.

Kaprizov drove the week with 5 points, including a hat trick against Florida, and Dylan Holloway had a three-assist night. Kaprizov's 6 goals on 13 shots are running hot, while Frondell lost his top power-play spot and Reinhart is centring a line without Barkov.
Next week, watch Sanderson's return from his lower-body injury, whether Johnston and Reinhart finally score, and Dom Scavuzzo's Hagel and Kucherov, who had 6 points each this week.

recap.impact: No threat to you. They lead you by 47 points today, but you're projected to finish about 99 points ahead of them.

recap.text: The title race is a three-way dead heat. Dom Scavuzzo jumped from 4th to 1st projected, with odds up from 11% to 18%. 97 Problems slipped to 2nd at 17%, and Lord of the Rinks sits 3rd at 17%. Debits & Checks are next at 9%.
recap.impact: You're right in it: about 6 projected points separate you from 1st, and the gap to 4th is about 15 points.

recap.text: Biggest movers: PhilCap fell from 3rd to 5th projected (9% to 8%) with Ivan Demidov and William Eklund both on injured reserve. Anthony Scavuzzo dropped from 11th to 14th after Travis Konecny and Mats Zuccarello went on injured reserve. In the real standings, Debits & Checks climbed from 9th to 2nd and RDR slid from 3rd to 10th.
recap.impact: Good for you. PhilCap was one of the teams projected just behind you a week ago, and now sits about 16 points back.

recap.text: Top pool scorers this week: Auston Matthews 9 points (Girl on the Lake), William Nylander 8 (Debits & Checks), and Alexis Lafreniere, Tim Stutzle and Sebastian Aho with 7 each. Dom Scavuzzo got 6 apiece from Brandon Hagel and Nikita Kucherov.
recap.impact: Hagel and Kucherov are the ones that hurt: they powered the team that just passed you. Kaprizov's 5 points led your roster.

recap.text: Role changes on your roster: Anton Frondell dropped from Chicago's top power-play unit to the second, Porter Martone moved up to Philadelphia's second line but back to the second power-play unit, and Brady Tkachuk moved onto Florida's top line. Sam Reinhart is centring Florida's second line with Aleksander Barkov out 6 to 8 weeks.
recap.impact: Small knocks for Frondell and Reinhart, who were already projected for modest totals. Martone's bigger even-strength role is a mild plus.

recap.text: Injuries: Jake Sanderson is still day-to-day with a lower-body injury and has played one game. Travis Konecny and Mats Zuccarello joined the injured reserve list, and Connor Bedard, Ryan Nugent-Hopkins and Mathew Barzal remain out.
recap.impact: Sanderson is the one to watch for you: he has one game played, and every game he misses is one fewer from your defence.
